entries.name: Breaker shunt-trip coil
entries.summary: Uses an externally supplied electrical pulse to release the breaker opening mechanism.

entries.name: Breaker trip coil one interface
entries.summary: Identifies the first opening coil in a breaker with separately wired trip paths.

entries.name: Breaker trip coil two interface
entries.summary: Identifies the second opening coil and its separately documented protection channel.

entries.name: Independent trip-supply changeover
entries.summary: Selects an available supply for a documented trip circuit without merging the two source circuits.

entries.name: Trip-coil pulse extension

entries.name: Trip-output interposing relay

entries.name: Protection trip distribution matrix

entries.name: Manual emergency-trip path
entries.summary: Shows the hardwired opening request issued by the designated emergency control station.

entries.name: Dual-channel trip segregation

entries.name: Trip positive-conductor supervision
entries.summary: Monitors continuity on the positive side of a documented breaker opening circuit.

entries.name: Trip return-conductor supervision
entries.summary: Monitors the documented return side rather than assuming a healthy positive feed proves continuity.

entries.name: Breaker open-trip seal-in contact
entries.summary: Sustains a trip request through its designed seal-in path until the specified feedback terminates it.

entries.name: Breaker trip-counter pulse
entries.summary: Produces a counting event when the defined trip operation is detected.

entries.name: Breaker closing-coil interface
entries.summary: Connects the final permitted close command to the breaker closing release.

entries.name: Breaker anti-pumping control

entries.name: Breaker close-pulse shaping
entries.summary: Converts a maintained supervisory request into the documented finite closing pulse.

entries.name: Spring-charged closing permissive

entries.name: Breaker open-position closing permissive

entries.name: Lockout-reset closing permissive

entries.name: Breaker ready-to-close aggregation

entries.name: Local closing-command channel

entries.name: Remote closing-command channel

entries.name: Closing-command priority selection

entries.name: Dead-bus close permission

entries.name: Live-bus synchronised closing gate

entries.name: Closing-circuit fuse-failure alarm

entries.name: Closing-coil isolation test link

entries.name: Breaker close-failure timer

entries.name: Close-command cancellation input
